p: took a wife: While Sarah was yet alive.
sons of the: For by virtue of God's word he not only had Isaac, but begat many more.
gave gifts: To avoid the disputing that otherwise might have come because of the heritage.
people: Who dwelt among the Arabians, and were separate from the blessed seed.
in the presence of all his: He means that his lot fell to dwell among his brethren as the angel promised.
thus: That is, with child, seeing one shall destroy another.
to enquire of the LORD: For that is the only refuge in all our miseries.
profit shall this birthright do to: The reprobate do not value God's benefits unless they feel them presently, and therefore they prefer present pleasures.
sold his birthright unto Jacob: Thus the wicked prefer their worldly conveniences over God's spiritual graces: but the children of God do the opposite.
